name: Broadcom Inc.
summary: Broadcom Inc. designs, develops, and supplies various semiconductor devices and infrastructure software solutions internationally. The company operates in two segments: Semiconductor Solutions and Infrastructure Software. The company offers networking connectivity, such as custom silicon solutions, ethernet switching & routing, ethernet NIC controllers, physical layer devices, and fiber optic comp
style_reason: erfüllt 8/9 Buffett-Kriterien und wächst trotzdem um 86 % pro Jahr – seltene Kombination
verdict: Einstufung: Qualitäts-Wachstum – erfüllt 8/9 Buffett-Kriterien und wächst trotzdem um 86 % pro Jahr – seltene Kombination. Buffett-Score 75/100 (Top-Firma, aber zu teuer), Innovations-Score 62/100 (Spannend). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 336.05 USD (+12 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Mittel.
